Face Painting League

Certificate check

Every FPL certificate has a unique number and a QR code. Enter the number to see who received the certificate and for which Game.

The number is printed at the bottom of the certificate. You can enter it without hyphens.

Where to find the number

  1. 1
    Number

    Bottom left. Enter it in the field above.

  2. 2
    QR code

    Point your phone camera at it. The check page opens and fills in the number automatically.

  3. How to read the number

    FPLleagueS1season01Game0247certificate number

Who gets a certificate

To everyone who submits all works of a Game by its end — including artists out of competition and those eliminated by the judges. Being late only means the Game does not count toward the season.

For clients and employers

An artist showed you an FPL certificate? Check the number here: you will see the name, Game, league and result.

Can't find a certificate?

Check the number again: 0 and O are often mixed up. If the number is correct but the certificate isn't found, message us in the bot and we'll sort it out.
